1.0.0.en: First release: local polling of Deye SG04LP3 hybrids via the Solarman logger.

1.1.0.en: More robust connection handling and polling. Finds the logger again after an IP change. Battery charge is a custom capability instead of measure_battery. Pairing fixes.

1.2.0.en: Surplus capability and token; flow cards: "value has been above/below a limit for N seconds", "set surplus offset", "restart history".

1.2.1.en: Status API (poll stats, history span, recent events) for diagnostics.
